title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Buyer's Order Signing and Contract-Date Postings
content:
**Accounting standing rule: what goes on a Vehicle Purchase Agreements deal on the contract date.**

A buyer's order is recorded only for a deal in reserved status, as shown by the deal's record. A deal already contracted, delivered or closed is not contracted again.

On the contract date the store posts the following to the deal:

| Item posted on the contract date | Amount and basis |
|---|---|
| Vehicle price | the agreed cash price |
| Documentary service fee and electronic filing service fee | as the documentary and filing fee rule of the Vehicle Purchase Agreements sets them |
| State title, registration and sales tax | as the title and registration rule sets them |
| Negative trade equity, if any | as the trade-in rule sets it |

**Financing terms on the contract.** A financed deal names its lienholder, the amount financed, the lender buy rate and the contract APR on the contract. A cash deal leaves these empty or at 0.00.

*Hypothetical:* a reserved deal signed on the 6th of a month with an agreed cash price of 18740.00 has 18740.00 posted as the vehicle price on the 6th. Its documentary and filing fees and its state amounts are posted the same day.
